caption: A warm, steaming bowl of ramen sits on a dark wooden table. The rich miso broth and fresh nori create a vibrant, comforting scene.

segments_info.text: Dark wooden table surface with subtle grain and natural wear
Frilly dark green nori curled at the edges, slightly damp and textured
The miso broth steams gently, golden-brown with fine bubbles and a velvety texture
Light beige ceramic bowl with smooth, slightly textured surface
Glossy white ceramic spoon with a smooth, polished edge
